name: Grade 6 T1 Practice: May Week 2 - Recycling and E-Waste
description: Practice words for responsible technology waste choices.

words.definition: To turn used materials into something useful again.
words.example: Some old devices can be recycled.
A working mouse can be reused by another student.

words.definition: To fix something so it works again.
words.example: Repairing a cable can reduce waste.
A broken phone can become e-waste.

words.definition: A part that stores power for a device.
words.example: A battery should be handled carefully.
Old batteries should not go in regular trash.
The class practiced sorting devices and batteries.

words.definition: Material that is thrown away or used carelessly.
words.example: Reusing a charger can reduce waste.

words.definition: The world around us, including air, water, land, and living things.
